methods.label: Find both made-shot totals
methods.explanation:
The percentages refer to different numbers of attempts, so first convert each percentage into a number of made shots. In her first \(20\) attempts, Sally made
\[
0.55\times20=11
\]
shots. After the next \(5\) attempts, she had taken \(25\) shots altogether and made
\[
0.56\times25=14.
\]
The increase in her made-shot total is \(14-11=3\). Therefore she made \(3\) of the last five shots, choice C.
